date.as_written: śrīmannepālikasamvat bindumekamunivarṣe māśī bhādrapades tathā | gaṅgāpakṣe tṛtiyañ ca nakṣatrañ ca hastam eva ṣubhajogaṃ śaniścare || ... samvat 710 bhādrapada[[śukla]]tṛtiyāṃ tithau haṣṭanakatre śubhayoge śaniścalavāra

notes: The chronogram 'bindv-eka-muni' gives 710, reiterated in digits as 'samvat 710'. 'Hedayasiṃha' is a vernacular form of Hṛdayasiṃha.
